summary: This is an EditorConfig file that sets code formatting rules for a project. It establishes baseline settings for all files (line endings and final newlines), then overrides those settings specifically for Makefiles to use tabs for indentation.

explanations.1: The [*] section header means the rules below apply to every file in the project.
explanations.2: This sets all files to use LF (line feed, the Unix-style line ending) instead of CRLF (Windows-style) or CR (old Mac-style).
explanations.3: This ensures every file ends with a newline character, which is a common best practice in Unix/Linux development.
explanations.5: The [Makefile] section header means the rules below override the [*] rules, but only for files named Makefile.
explanations.6: This tells the editor to use actual tab characters for indentation in Makefiles (rather than spaces), which is required by Makefile syntax.
